description: Grant a customer a prepaid credit bundle: pass customer_id and amount, and optionally currency (default USD), expires_at and metadata. The balance starts at the amount. Needs a claimed Last Price credential with billing write scope. Needs a claimed workspace: a sandbox key from self-registration is refused (403) until a person claims the workspace.

currency.description: The currency code. Defaults to USD.

customer_id.description: The customer: its id, as list_customers shows it.

expires_at.description: When the bundle expires, as an RFC 3339 date-time.

metadata.description: Anything worth keeping with the record.

name: create_credit
